description: List tax lots on a street (prefix match, e.g. "Grattan St") and/or in a ZIP code, with address, building class, units, owner of record and open-item count. Requires "street" and/or "zip"; borough and house_number only narrow the search. Paginate with limit/offset; total is the number of matches.

house_number.description: Optional house number, sent as text

street.description: Street name, e.g. "Grattan St" or "5th Ave". Required unless "zip" is given.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP, sent as text. Required unless "street" is given.

name: search_properties
title: Search NYC properties by street and/or ZIP
